development_evidence: 1ea7d80 real 4B/14B native development samples, 20 turns each, all40 provider calls stop per model; no SMS/phone execution receipts
scope: Reply system-prompt-only experimental subclass. Default Avatar factories unchanged. No post-hoc edits, regex censor, replay, additional model/tool call, or self-scored semantic release.
inventory: Build a metadata-only manifest from current REGISTRY.names/schemas, record that this ordinary generation branch invoked no tools. Known unsupported SMS/email/telephone names must actually be absent. No raw memory/contact data or reminder titles copied into capability metadata.
prompt_contract: Real assistant execution requires actual capability and execution receipt. A user's request, drafted text, previous unsupported assistant claim or authorization is not a receipt.
No current SMS/email/telephone interface: do not claim, promise, offer execution or solicit contact details for it; can give user-owned drafts for manual sending.
Quoted text, fiction and first-person user composition may contain completed-delivery wording. Preserve task perspective/literals; do not rewrite drafts into AI no-body disclaimers.

Local reminder creation/cancellation only through existing explicit independent real-user rule path. Ordinary generated text does not create an action. Prior genuine rule receipt may be acknowledged, but local delivery depends on program running and polling.
Reality confirmation alone cannot reactivate a blocked old role action or promise its delivery. New real action needs a subsequent independent explicit request.
Metadata describes current route, not a universal semantic verifier or proof that any unspecified historical request succeeded. No background/delivery guarantees.
development_gate: First controlled SDK/HTTP tests: production prompt byte-equivalent, exact current registry/no writes/no extra calls, quote/fiction/draft unchanged when provider supplies it, local reminder positive and role/exit negatives, cancellation/privacy remain. Then fixed paired development12 if source freeze allows only development.
prospective_gate: Only after source/evidence freeze explicitly authorizes prospective: paired12 in preregistered order, fresh DB per arm, complete raw/visible/final/stored and actual side effects. Keep known failures as regression, do not call them independent validation. Agent span assessment remains separate and not independent-human approval.
failure_policy: Retain originals; revise only in development with new version/freeze, never silently change during a model run or retroactively relabel prospective as pass.
